blocks.text: WAREHOUSE CLEANOUT FAQ
Warehouse Cleanout Services in Bolton — FAQs

items.q: What does a warehouse cleanout in Bolton include?
a: Mostly the racking — how many bays, how many beam levels — plus what is on the floor and whether cold storage, plant or a mezzanine is coming out. We come and look, give you a figure in writing, and that is the figure. It does not move because the job ran longer than we expected.

items.q: Do you provide commercial warehouse junk removal in Bolton?
a: Usually that anything the tenant installed goes — racking, mezzanine, partitions, added lighting and services — and the building returns roughly as handed over, floor anchors included. Bolton units go back to market fast and landlords here inspect properly, so it is worth reading the surrender clause before you get quotes. We compare installed against original at the walkthrough.

items.q: Can you remove wooden pallets from my Bolton warehouse?
a: Yes. Beams, uprights, wire decking, cantilever arms, drive-in bays, safety barriers and floor anchors all come down in sequence and go. Pallet racking removal is usually the biggest part of the job, and a quote that has not accounted for it properly will change on you partway through.

items.q: Do you remove old warehouse shelving?
a: Yes. We can remove accepted removable shelving, storage units and warehouse racks. Larger pieces may need to be dismantled into manageable sections before removal.

Yes. Machinery, plant and steel mezzanines with offices above the shipping bay all come out with the rest of the building, with scrap steel weighed and recycled. Anything needing specialist disconnection or an engineer’s sign-off gets flagged at the walkthrough rather than partway through.
